name: config-check-mcp
description: Validates configuration files (JSON, JSON with comments, YAML, TOML) against the schema for their file name from SchemaStore: tsconfig.json, package.json, docker-compose.yml, GitHub workflows, ESLint, Renovate and 1,400+ more. Every error has its line and path, the allowed values, and the property you probably meant for a misspelled key; and any setting can be looked up with its description and allowed values. No key.

dependencyReasons.ajv: The reference JSON Schema validator; SchemaStore tests its own schemas with Ajv, and they use enough of every draft that a small validator would get them wrong.
dependencyReasons.ajv-formats: The string formats schemas declare (uri, email, date-time, regex...), checked as the schema intends.
dependencyReasons.jsonc-parser: JSON with comments and trailing commas (tsconfig, VS Code settings), with node offsets to report line numbers.
dependencyReasons.yaml: YAML 1.2 parsing with source positions, for compose files, workflows and other YAML configs.
dependencyReasons.smol-toml: TOML 1.0 parsing for pyproject.toml, Cargo.toml and similar configs.
